description: Fetch a single task by id, including its content_hash for optimistic-concurrency edits (chain into update_task/complete_task/delete_task's if_hash). `status` is canonical; `status_label` is what the user sees in this vault.

fields.description:
Project the returned task to only these fields (e.g.
`["id","title","due"]`) — a token-cost lever. Names are validated
against the task-record fields; an unknown name is a usage error
listing the valid set. Omit for the full record (default; the response
is byte-identical to before this option existed).

name: get_task
